build_resnet18_model: build a ResNet-18 model with BasicBlock using specified in_channels, base_planes, and ngroups parameters
build_resnet50_model: build a ResNet-50 model with Bottleneck blocks using specified in_channels, base_planes, and ngroups parameters
build_resnext50_model: build a ResNeXt-50 model with grouped convolutions and cardinality based on base_planes divided by 2
build_se_resnet50_model: build a SE-ResNet-50 model with Squeeze-and-Excitation attention modules in each Bottleneck block
build_se_resnext101_model: build a SE-ResNeXt-101 model with SE attention and grouped convolutions using 23 blocks in layer3
